note: Hosted classification of every tool of the ssam MCP server (docs/FASE2-AGENTE.md section 5 and 6.4), the four hook tools that the product lists only with SSAM_APP_HOOK_TOOLS=1 included. class: server | agent | tenant-agent | unavailable. lane: o11 | odc | none | arg:<default>. agent: always | never | report | {when, arg|args, values}. paths: JSON Pointers of the file arguments, in (read) and out (written). Read by hosted/policy.mjs; tests/hosted-tools.test.mjs keeps it complete against the live registry.

ssam_discover.reason: Catalog and module index on the server; app as a module name captures through the user's Studio. The environment components of an O11 intent (installed extensions and Forge components for a PDF, Excel...) are listed through the user's own Service Studio (the agent) and kept in the customer's own folder; their actions are the names of the published signatures (the extension XIF read and the published-module digest stay off hosted).

ssam_map.reason: Module index on the server; a module name captures the open module through the agent. Views search and uses take a list of targets: each capture is a path of the workspace, each module name captures through the agent. Views ddl, logic, flow and html read the same captures; the keysFile, ddlFile and flowFile they name are files of the server's module index and show as <server>.

ssam_code.reason: The module as code, every file of it this user's. read is ssam_map over a capture of the workspace; a module name captures the open module through the agent. check and plan take the newest capture of the module from ws:o11/snapshots or ws:odc/snapshots (a base only from there, never another .oml) and the producer captures of this workspace, and write their jobs and plans in ws:o11/ and ws:odc/lab/; files, stubs, shared and the job of basedOn are files of the workspace, and the paths inside the ops a call makes are confined as a job's. A plan names the files its subagents write in the agent inbox of the user's machine and brings its prompts there. write delivers through o11_deliver or studio_deliver, the same gate. An edit of logic expands only a read this user was served.

off.reason: The module as code is not served on this hosted server yet. Read the module as text with ssam_map (views ddl, flow, html) and deliver the change with o11_deliver or studio_deliver.

continuation.why: Reads the module as text (view ddl, flow or html, target: the capture or the open module); the change then goes as ONE job of o11_deliver (O11) or studio_deliver (ODC).

ssam_app_url.reason: URL built with the user's own tenants; without environment and tenant it reads the Studio status.

ssam_reference.reason: Kernel catalogs on the server. check-job reads a job of the workspace; {basedOn, patch?, job?} reads the job of basedOn and a partial job file from the workspace too.

ssam_evidence.reason: Reads only JSON evidence under odc/, o11/ and inbox/ of the user's workspace, the paged answers of this user (ws:o11/answers) included.

ssam_task.reason: Long tasks of the user's workspace (ws:o11/tasks) and, read only, the user's destructive operations (ws:state/destructive: deleting is off hosted, so none is listed). close runs the kernel close of a delivery task of this user's own work folder (ws:o11/work), whose hash proof captures the user's module through the relay; stop aborts a call of this user still running in this server before its next send; another user's task id is never found.

ssam_grant.reason: Standing grants of this user only: the grants file is in the user's workspace (state/grants, never the owner's .local/grants nor another user's); a grant authorizes o11_deliver, o11_publish and studio_deliver publish:true of this user only.

ssam_job.reason: Fixture proof on the server; producer capture through the Studio session. lane odc without base runs on a neutral blank CrossDevice app in hosted mode (no OutSystemsUI); pass base (a studio_snapshot capture) for a job over the user's module. A job with the prototype op is refused hosted (HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause PROTOTYPE_SOURCE_LOCAL); so is a generator op not offered here yet (entity-actions, rest-consume, screen with data.generate: HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause GENERATOR_PENDING).

o11_job.reason: Fixture proof on the server; producer capture through the Studio session. A job with the prototype op is refused hosted (HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause PROTOTYPE_SOURCE_LOCAL); so is a generator op not offered here yet (entity-actions, rest-consume, screen with data.generate: HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause GENERATOR_PENDING).

o11_inspect.reason: Resident reader on the server; module captures through the bridge.

studio_inspect.reason: Reader on the server; a module name captures through the Studio.

o11_access.reason: plan is offline; apply runs deliveries through the bridge (relay).

odc_receipt.reason: Receipts in the workspace; reconcile reads the tenant once.

studio_build.reason: Headless builder on the server with SSAM_HYBRID_ODC_ROOT=<ws>/odc.

odc_status.reason: Catalog coverage; no credential state of the server's owner.

ssam_friction.reason: The friction queue of this user (customers/<id>/.local/friction).

odc_a2a_connection_plan.reason: Pure preparation of a no_auth A2A connection from the explicit stage, portfolio and agent card: it does not authenticate, contact the endpoint or reserve a receipt (outside the tenant tools). With discoveryOperationUuid it reads that confirmed discovery receipt from this account's own journal (ws:odc/journal/portal/receipts); a receipt of another account is not found.

ssam_doctor.reason: Agent state, versions and the user's Studios; answers without the agent and says it is missing. task {id, stop|close} reads, stops or closes a call of this user's own ws:o11/tasks, never another user's.

studio_doctor.reason: The same on the ODC side; never dotnet, builds or the owner's vault.

ssam_connect.reason: Attach to the user's Studios with the binaries of the agent package: without lane every lane of this user's token, each Studio listed, probed and attached through the user's agent.

o11_deliver.reason: CLI deliver on the server; snapshot, refresh, merge and, with publish:true, the publication through the user's bridge via the relay. Without authorize only a standing grant of this user (ssam_grant) counts. A job with the prototype op is refused hosted (HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause PROTOTYPE_SOURCE_LOCAL); so is a generator op not offered here yet (entity-actions, rest-consume, screen with data.generate: HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause GENERATOR_PENDING).

o11_studio.reason: Bridge commands. refresh-references with add or published:true (the Studio's own Manage Dependencies by code) runs in the user's Studio through the O11 bridge of the agent package (capability refresh_references:add); with an older agent package's bridge it answers HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause MANAGE_DEPENDENCIES_HOSTED_PENDING, nothing sent (install the current agent package and restart Service Studio); without add and published the Studio's own Refresh References runs.

o11_publish.reason: 1-Click Publish of the user's Studio; refresh-publish (refreshReferences) refreshes the references of the open tab first, in the same Studio. Without authorize only a standing grant of this user (ssam_grant) counts.

studio_assets.reason: Native listing in the Studio; mirrors snapshots/modules.json.

studio_data_insert.reason: Data service of the Studio; the records file goes to the agent.

studio_data_update.reason: Data service of the Studio; the records file goes to the agent.

studio_open.reason: Bridge; localOml goes to the agent.

ssam_query_test.reason: ODC: the native TestQuery of the user's ODC Studio, the capture sent by sha256 through the agent. O11 is refused hosted (the thin bridge has no query test).

studio_snapshot.reason: Capture on the user's machine, OML mirrored in the workspace.

studio_reference_snapshot.reason: The .avsig is written on the user's machine and brought back.

studio_latest.reason: Native download in the user's Studio.

studio_merge.reason: 3-way merge with the base the server sent.

studio_authorize.reason: The bridge writes the authorization into the manifest, which comes back to the server.

studio_create_app.reason: Headless model on the server (evidence in ws:odc/lab/create-app/); create-app, open and publish in the user's Studio. authorizationContext is a file of the user's workspace, and so is the proposal it names.

studio_command.reason: Direct pass-through; the command list and the final line are the agent's.

studio_deliver.reason: Snapshot and merge on the user's machine; build on the server; publish:true publishes in the user's Studio after a clean merge, with the user's words or a standing grant of this user (ssam_grant). producers {Name: capture or OML} are files of this user's workspace, as for o11_deliver; "published" is no path. A job with the prototype op is refused hosted (HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause PROTOTYPE_SOURCE_LOCAL); so is a generator op not offered here yet (entity-actions, rest-consume, screen with data.generate: HOSTED_UNAVAILABLE, cause GENERATOR_PENDING).

studio_reference_producers.reason: The bridge command reference-producers <Module> in the open consumer of the user's ODC Studio: producer names and keys, read only (the consumer stays unchanged).

o11_data.reason: Edit Data through the session of the user's Studio (data --studio via the relay); a batch with $ref steps is one request file in ws:o11/data/requests, its references are record ids, never paths.

o11_service_center_session.reason: sc_session and the headless sc_http session (capability sc_http:studioSession) of the user's own Service Studio. Session vault, credentialTarget and the stored profiles answer HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY; the credential window and authPrompt never open (HOSTED_PROMPT_UNAVAILABLE); LifeTime is refused.

o11_service_center_read.reason: sc_api and the headless sc_http (sc_http:studioSession) of the user's own Service Studio (integration-log-detail included); capabilities and receipt answer from the server. Session vault, stored profiles, sc_private_http, single sign-on, LifeTime and timer-events answer HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY before any attempt; no prompt opens. Receipts, exports and solution-download records stay in ws:o11/service-center.

o11_service_center_write.reason: Prepare, execute and verify talk to the host through the user's Studio session (sc_api, sc_http); value/.osp/.xif files and the authorizationContext (and the proposal it names) are files of the workspace and, for the upload, mirrored to the agent. Vault, profiles, sc_private_http and prompts are refused as in the reads.

odc_auth_status.reason: Sessions of the user's Studio (auth-status); vault columns unavailable in hosted mode.

odc_read.reason: portal-call in the user's ODC Studio; the request file is written in ws:odc/journal/portal/requests and mirrored to the agent, never under a bridge root of the server. auth api-client is refused (HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY).

odc_write.reason: portal-call in the user's ODC Studio, the request file mirrored from ws:odc/journal/portal/requests; a secret only by secretRefs, read by the user's bridge from the user's vault. authorizationContext is a file of the workspace (the proposal it names too).

odc_portal_read.reason: portal-session fetch through the headless session of the user's ODC Studio (no window); the request file is mirrored from ws:odc/journal/portal/requests. auth portal-credential, the stored profiles and the private transport (portal-private-*) answer HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY.

odc_portal_write.reason: portal-session fetch through the headless session of the user's ODC Studio; vaultFile names an entry of the user's own vault, read by the user's bridge. auth portal-credential, the stored profiles and portal-private-* answer HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY; no prompt.

odc_portal_login.reason: Status, open and close of the headless Portal session (portal-session) in the user's ODC Studio; no window. action select-profile and auth portal-credential answer HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY; action prompt and focus (the private credential window) answer HOSTED_PROMPT_UNAVAILABLE before the Studio, the vault or a profile is read.

odc_portal_routes.reason: GETs through the headless Portal session of the user's ODC Studio.

odc_operation_status.reason: The headless session of the user's ODC Studio.

odc_deploy.reason: The headless session of the user's ODC Studio; authorizationContext is a file of the workspace.

odc_configurations.reason: The headless session of the user's ODC Studio. A secret setting (vaultSettings, vaultConfigurations, mobile-extensibility included) only from an entry already in the user's own vault, read by the user's bridge; no prompt and no vault of the server. authorizationContext is a file of the workspace.

odc_asset_delete.reason: The headless session of the user's ODC Studio; authorizationContext is a file of the workspace.

odc_external_db_connection.reason: A secret only when it is already in the user's own vault (read by the bridge); no prompt in hosted mode. authorizationContext is a file of the workspace.

odc_mcp_connection.reason: portalRead through the headless session of the user's ODC Studio (portal-session). auth portal-credential answers HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY.

odc_mcp_import.reason: portalWrite through the headless session of the user's ODC Studio, the receipt in the user's workspace. auth portal-credential answers HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY.

odc_a2a_connection_delete.reason: portalRead and portalWrite through the headless session of the user's ODC Studio; authorizationContext is a file of the workspace. auth portal-credential answers HOSTED_STUDIO_SESSION_ONLY.

hybrid_tenants.reason: Sessions of the user's Studio and ws:odc/tenants.json; never the owner's tenants.json.

ssam_debug.reason: The debugger publishes a wrapper and uses the private vault of app users, ssam-debug pipes and local hooks of the server machine.

ssam_debug_run.reason: The debugger publishes a wrapper and uses the private vault of app users, ssam-debug pipes and local hooks of the server machine.

ssam_debug_invoke.reason: The debugger uses the private vault of app users, local hooks and browser profiles (CDP) of the server machine.

ssam_debug_server.reason: The server debugger session publishes a wrapper and uses the private vault of app users, ssam-debug pipes and local hooks of the server machine (the same reason as ssam_debug).

ssam_debug_client.reason: The client debugger session uses the private vault of app users, local hooks and browser profiles (CDP) of the server machine (the same reason as ssam_debug).

ssam_debug_matrix.reason: The debugger matrix reads and writes the evidence of .local/debugger of the server machine (the owner's), never a customer's.

odc_native_package.reason: API Client only: it signs in with the API Client of the server's vault and saves the package in the server's journal. Hosted, only the session of the user's own ODC Studio is a path. The user downloads the native package in ODC Portal.

arguments.intent: read the status of a native mobile build through the Studio session

continuation.why: The build status is read through the user's own ODC Studio session; the package itself is downloaded by the user in ODC Portal.

odc_generated_code.reason: API Client only: it signs in with the API Client of the server's vault and saves the generated-code package in the server's journal. Hosted, only the session of the user's own ODC Studio is a path. The user downloads the generated code in ODC Portal.

arguments.intent: read the builds and deployments of an ODC app through the Studio session

continuation.why: Builds and deployments are read through the user's own ODC Studio session; the generated code itself is downloaded by the user in ODC Portal.

odc_asset_source.reason: API Client only (its auth is the literal api-client): it reads the revision source with the API Client of the server's vault and saves it in the server's journal. Hosted, only the session of the user's own ODC Studio is a path.

continuation.why: Downloads the latest published revision through the user's own ODC Studio (native DownloadService) into ws:odc/snapshots; studio_snapshot captures the open module instead.

odc_asset_revision.reason: API Client only: it uploads an OML (file, candidateProof) as a new revision with the API Client of the server's vault. Hosted, only the session of the user's own ODC Studio is a path: a new revision is made by a delivery in that Studio.

arguments.intent: deliver a change to an ODC module through the Studio with studio_deliver

continuation.why: studio_deliver merges the change in the user's own ODC Studio and, with publish:true and the user's words, publishes the new revision in the same call.

context.reason: The controlled session needs the trusted hook (UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse) on the MCP client machine; the server cannot verify it.

propose.reason: The controlled session needs the trusted hook (UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse) on the MCP client machine; the server cannot verify it.

continue.reason: The controlled session needs the trusted hook (UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse) on the MCP client machine; the server cannot verify it.

status.reason: The controlled session needs the trusted hook (UserPromptSubmit/PreToolUse) on the MCP client machine; the server cannot verify it.

ssam_preview.reason: The local preview starts processes and a browser address on 127.0.0.1 of the machine that runs SSAM, from profiles prepared on that machine: a hosted server cannot show it on the user's machine.

o11_extension.reason: The .NET extension (XIF) is built by the Integration Studio engine (.NET Framework 4.7.2, x86, Windows only), which the Linux server image does not carry; on a Windows server its spec files, work and receipts are not yet confined per account. Build and publish the extension on your own Windows machine (Integration Studio, or o11_extension of an SSAM installed there), then reference it here.

arguments.intent: reference an existing .NET extension (XIF) from an O11 module

continuation.why: The extension is published from the user's Windows machine; this shows how to reference it from a module on this server (ssam_job op reference, then o11_deliver).

odc_external_library.reason: The library is built on the server machine with dotnet publish and NuGet packages the spec names (package build steps run code on that machine); not yet isolated per account. Build and upload the library in ODC Portal, then reference it with studio_deliver.
